scope: Local storage cleanup only. No commit, push, deployment, database write, dependency change or Git history rewrite.

measurement.method: du -sk allocated project storage, including ignored files and Git; not a claim about APFS container free space or remote repository size.
measurement.note: The initial snapshot precedes stopping the local preview server; the detailed inventory was 312 KiB smaller after shutdown. Measurement includes the retained compressed audit inventory.

classification.SAFE TO DELETE: 29 verified Next.js build directories, the current generated Playwright report/results, TypeScript incremental cache and root Finder metadata. All were untracked. References point to regenerating commands, build-output configuration or historical build paths, not source inputs.
classification.LIKELY STALE: 74 duplicate-content groups (about 21 MiB redundant bytes), historical screenshots/reports, private baseline source copies and old test traces. Kept because byte equality or age alone does not prove that an evidence or recovery path can be removed.
classification.KEEP: Application source, all tests, package manifest/lockfile, multi-platform deployment dependencies, production/public media, current blog drafts, branding, migrations, legal/SEO files, configuration and current documentation. The existing dirty working tree was preserved.
classification.REQUIRES MY APPROVAL: Private reference photos and generated identity outputs, database snapshots/rollback SQL, original downloads, historical source baselines and any release-evidence retirement. No such material was deleted.

removed.recovery: Disposable generated output was permanently removed, not moved to Trash. Rebuild/retest using retained source and lockfile. Historical source snapshots, release reports and database rollback records remain available.

dependencies.reason: Every declared dependency has a source, tooling, configuration, script or test role. Type packages are consumed implicitly by TypeScript; Prettier is invoked by package scripts. Lighthouse and Sharp have active scripts. pnpm-workspace.yaml intentionally includes Linux runtime binaries for Netlify alongside macOS binaries.
dependencies.validation: pnpm list --depth 0 and offline frozen-lockfile lockfile-only install passed; package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml are unchanged.
dependencies.caveat: The initial ordinary offline install requested replacing node_modules and aborted because no TTY was available. It was not forced. Existing dependencies were retained and validated by compilation, unit tests and browser tests.

ignoreChanges..gitignore: Replace enumerated alternate Next build directories with /.next-*/. Add root-local tooling caches, coverage intermediates, Playwright blob/cache output and package-manager debug logs. Do not blanket-ignore documentation, reports, assets, .bak files or original downloads.
ignoreChanges..prettierignore: Exclude alternate Next builds, private working material, local cache and blob reports from formatting.
ignoreChanges.eslint.config.mjs: Exclude alternate Next builds consistently, plus local cache and blob reports.

trackedArtifactAudit.note: Tracked documentation media, logs and JSON reports were reviewed as historical editorial/release evidence rather than automatically removed. Git reported two temporary objects totaling 16.93 MiB; all Git internals were left untouched.

validation.content: 193 records validated, 104 published and 89 deferred drafts, no missing images
validation.seo: passed with 0 errors and 47 existing editorial review notices; no editorial changes made
validation.releaseFestivalBlogChecks: passed; all 7 local blog source envelopes remain drafts
validation.defaultBuild: Blocked twice by local Turbopack worker process/port EPERM, including elevated retry. No application compilation error was established.
validation.webpackProductionBuild: passed: next build --webpack plus preview-cache-headers, 159 pages generated, seed data only and advertising/analytics disabled
validation.browserTests: 61 of 62 desktop/mobile tests passed. Mobile no-JavaScript pagination timed out waiting for the full page load on the initial run and isolated retry. A separate mobile no-JavaScript DOMContentLoaded check passed: 24 cards on page one, Load more navigation to page two, 24 cards there. Local page and pending image each returned HTTP 200. Full-load timeout remains unresolved; no test or product code was changed to mask it. Failure trace retained privately.
validation.productionDatabaseIntegration: Not run; this cleanup made no runtime, database, migration or production changes.
validation.formatting: ESLint configuration Prettier check and git diff --check passed. Ignore files have no Prettier parser and were checked as patterns instead.

approvalOnlyFollowups.reason: Historical source/asset baselines may be needed for recovery or comparison; retained.
May contain account/user data and investigation evidence; explicit retirement approval required.

approvalOnlyFollowups.category: Historical documentation media and raw reports
approvalOnlyFollowups.reason: Includes source evidence, release records and maintained documentation, not all disposable. Any further archival needs a reference-preserving plan and approval.

integrity: All 1434 originally tracked files remain. SHA-256 comparison against the start-of-cleanup working contents shows only .gitignore, .prettierignore and eslint.config.mjs changed. Existing uncommitted content/documentation/test work was preserved. No files were removed from Git tracking. Validation build and transient outputs were removed again after stopping the local server; the unresolved browser failure trace was retained.
privateEvidence: .release-private/storage-cleanup-20261010/before.json.gz contains the complete filename/size inventory, reference-search results, dependency evidence, duplicate groups and original tracked-file hashes. deleted.json lists guarded deletion targets. nojs-diagnostic.json and nojs-full-load-timeout/ preserve browser diagnostic evidence. No secret values were exported.
localPreview: Both local servers used during this task were stopped. The previous localhost:4312 blog preview can be restarted with node scripts/blog-seed-preview.mjs; source drafts remain unchanged. pnpm build (or next build --webpack when the local Turbopack permission limitation applies) regenerates the production build before pnpm start.
